depends_on.name: item_id
depends_on.documentation: The DISTINCT documents the value names, deduplicated, in order: any document. Value k names the k-th entry (0-based, T14). A stimulus given as a RECIPE is a `method` document, one per distinct stimulus (term "drifting sinusoidal grating", parameters orientation / spatial frequency / temporal frequency / contrast / waveform ...; a blank is its own `method` document). A stimulus given as WHAT WAS DELIVERED (a movie's frames, a current trace) is the value for that quantity. A subject, for a track's nearest patch. (V_eta_method_plan.md, 2026-10-21: a stimulus is no longer a class per kind, such as the deleted `visual_grating`.)

fields.name: value
fields.documentation: At each position along the value's `dimensions`, ONE document out of the ordered list of distinct documents in `item_id`: the stimulus shown at each presentation, the patch nearest the worm in each video frame. The dimensions and their covariates are whatever the statement needs (a stimulus sequence: one presentation dimension with covariates `onset time`, `offset time` when the source recorded ends, and `control condition` (XCO:0000099, `logical`) when it named a control; a track: a frame dimension with a time covariate); the values may sit in a body when there are many, and `value` is then absent (as for every value with a body). The `variable` says what kind of item it is. (`timed_sequence` until 2026-10-04. `offset` and `control_item` were deleted 2026-10-22 for the `offset time` and `control condition` covariates, data_body plan AMENDMENT 6 and Jess Haley, 2026-10-22 [control as covariate], V_eta_stimulus_response_model_plan.md.)

fields.name: item
fields.documentation: One 0-based position in `item_id` per position along the dimensions (value k names the k-th `item_id` entry). A position with no item is empty: NaN inline, the body's `fill_value` when the values are in a body. (`presentation_order` until 2026-10-04.)
